title: Ugali: Tanzania's Everyday Staple
excerpt: Ugali is the everyday staple of Tanzania: a firm maize porridge eaten with your hands. How it is made and how to eat it.
body:
## What is ugali?

Ugali is made from maize flour and water, cooked into a firm dough. Similar dishes exist across Africa.

## How to eat it

Roll a small ball with your right hand, press a dent with your thumb and use it to scoop up stew, vegetables or fish.

## With what

- Beans
- Spinach or other greens (mchicha)
- Fish (for example from Lake Victoria)
- Meat stew
- [Nyama choma](/blog/nyama-choma/)

## Taste

Neutral, filling and comforting.

## Try it

Ask your guide for a local restaurant, or ask your lodge to serve ugali one evening.
